headlines.title: Binance says user funds are safe after thieves make off with billions in largest-ever crypto hack
headlines.description: A record-setting cyberattack targeting the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange has rocked the digital assets industry.

headlines.title: Tech stocks wipe out more than $1.5 trillion as concerns deepen about the AI boom
headlines.description: Tech stocks plunged, putting the Nasdaq 100 index on course for a more than $1.5 trillion drop.

headlines.title: ExxonMobil and Chevron report blowout profits as Trump touts benefits of high oil prices
headlines.description: The two largest U.S. oil companies, ExxonMobil and Chevron reported blowout profits as oil prices remain sharply elevated due to the U.S. war with Iran.

headlines.title: Binance targeted in $6.3 billion crypto heist, the largest ever
headlines.description: The company has suspended all deposits and withdrawals while it works with law enforcement to secure its infrastructure and locate stolen funds.

headlines.title: Alphabet shares record their worst day ever, shedding $500B in value
headlines.description: Shares of Google parent company Alphabet sank 12.6%, the company’s worst ever single-day drop.

headlines.title: Polymarket briefly halts trading after third-party compromise and reports of stolen user funds
headlines.description: Predictions markets platform Polymarket was forced to halt trading on its international platform for an hour after a vendor was compromised.

headlines.title: Tech Stocks Plummet; Hackers Steal Over $6B in Cryptocurrency
headlines.description: Wall Street will be looking to bounce back after a very tough day for tech companies on Thursday that saw shares of Amazon, Intel and Google’s parent company Alphabet plummet. It comes as the crypto industry suffered the biggest heist in history with hackers making off with nearly $6 billion in cryptocurrency. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Google stock's historically bad day raises fears of AI bubble popping
headlines.description: Google's parent company Alphabet lost over $500 billion in market value today. So is the AI bubble about to pop? NBC News' Allie Canal reports on big tech's spending and how AI is impacting the job market.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve keeps interest rates unchanged in final vote before midterms
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve has voted to keep interest rates unchanged despite rising inflation. NBC News' Brian Chueng reports on the central bank's final rate decision before the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Tools and Hacks to Find the Best Prices on Groceries, Gas, More
headlines.description: NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to share tools to track down the biggest bargains and make sure you are getting the best price with the holidays approaching. Tips include using Google’s new Universal Cart for price tracking alerts, Upside to earn cashback on gas and more!

headlines.title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart for $17 billion, creating delivery giant
headlines.description: The company has emerged as the most successful stand-alone online delivery platform, commanding some two-thirds of all food delivery volumes in the U.S.

headlines.title: Fed plans to eliminate some rate-setting meetings, chairman says
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve plans to eliminate some meetings devoted to setting interest rates in the next couple of years, Chairman Kevin Warsh said Wednesday.
